Home Fitness App (Hybrid Calisthenics)
The accessibility of progressions is one of the best things about calisthenics.
However, the limited amount that we use (or know about) can sometimes keep us stuck. We're sometimes trying to do the equivalent of jumping 50lb in a weightlifting exercise. Almost no weightlifter would want to do that (except when they're starting out and still finding their best weight etc). However, it's often the norm in calisthenics.
